description: Defines the WeatherApiService interface with methods for fetching current weather, forecast, and location search, using Retrofit annotations.

classes.name: WeatherApiService
classes.description: Interface defining API endpoints for weather data, including current weather, forecast, and location search.

methods.name: getCurrentWeather
methods.description: Fetches current weather data for a specified location using a GET request to 'current.json'.

methods.name: getForecast
methods.description: Retrieves weather forecast data for a location over a specified number of days via a GET request to 'forecast.json'.

methods.name: searchLocations
methods.description: Searches for locations matching a query via a GET request to 'search.json'.
